about.story_tagline: Built on Trust, Focused on Trade, Committed to Growth

company.p1: Fursa Energy is an indigenous Nigerian company focused on the distribution, marketing, and development of high-performance lubricants for both automotive and industrial applications. We serve as the official Super Distributor for MRS Lubricants, one of Africa’s most reputable blending facilities located in Apapa, Lagos.
company.p2: With a strong presence across Nigeria, Fursa is positioning itself as the go-to partner for trade, logistics, and supply of best-in-class lubricants designed to reduce friction, protect machinery, and enhance operational efficiency.

story.p1: Not all journeys begin on the open road — but ours is driven by what fuels it. Fursa Energy was born out of a vision: to be more than just a distributor of lubricants, but a catalyst for industrial performance, economic empowerment, and trusted trade partnerships across Africa.
story.p2: In a market where reliability often takes a backseat, Fursa set out to raise the standard — delivering premium lubricants at scale while building a commercial ecosystem where partners thrive. At the heart of our story is motion: engines turning, economies rising, businesses scaling. Backed by MRS Oil PLC — one of Africa’s largest lubricant blending plants — Fursa Energy proudly delivers world-class formulations to power vehicles, machines, and industries that drive progress.
story.p3: From the trucking routes of the North to the coastal economies of the South, we don’t just distribute — we empower a network of dealers, distributors, and institutions with the tools to succeed. Every drop we supply fuels a larger story of innovation, excellence, and opportunity. Fursa is not just a brand — it is a movement of trust, trade, and growth in motion.

story_more.p1: Begin on the open road. Push through the storm. When the job demands the unthinkable, productivity cannot compromise. Across Africa’s toughest conditions, we build for performance that lasts.
story_more.p2: Fursa’s modern blends refuse subpar substitutes. Our products are precision-engineered partners for unrivaled machine protection. From the bustling streets of Lagos to the rugged trails of the Sahel, our portfolio meets Africa’s unique driving terrain.
story_more.p3: From northern cities to southern coasts and the Sahelian arc to the west, our expertise is tailored to Africa’s roads. Partner with us for lubricants that keep businesses moving. Let’s drive progress across Africa — together.

about.vision_desc: To be West Africa's most dependable and innovative energy solutions provider, delivering outstanding value and fostering partnerships that last.
about.mission_desc: To provide premium lubricants and energy solutions, supporting businesses with quality products, exceptional service, and sustainable practices that drive growth and development.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Explore answers to common questions about our lubricants, distribution process, delivery timeline, and product verification.
faq.q1: What types of lubricants does Fursa offer?
faq.a1_html:
Fursa Energy offers a wide range of premium-quality lubricants, including:
  • Automotive Lubricants: Engine oils, gear oils, brake fluids, transmission fluids.
  • Industrial Lubricants: Hydraulic oils, compressor oils, turbine oils, and specialty greases.
  • Greases: Lithium complex greases, multipurpose and heavy-duty greases.
  • Marine & Heavy Equipment Oils: High-performance lubricants for ships, tractors, and construction equipment.

All products are blended in one of the largest state-of-the-art blending plants in Africa, certified for quality and performance.
faq.q2: How do I become a distributor?
faq.a2_html:
Becoming a Fursa Energy distributor is simple:
  1. Click on the "Become a Distributor" button on our website
  2. Complete the online registration form with your business information
  3. Submit required documents (CAC certificate, business license, etc.)
  4. Our team will review your application within 48-72 hours
  5. Once approved, you'll receive onboarding materials and training

For more information, contact our distributor support team at partners@@fursaenergy.com
faq.q3: What is the delivery timeline for orders?
faq.a3_html:
Our delivery timelines are designed to ensure prompt service:
  • Lagos & Abuja: 24-48 hours for orders placed before 2 PM
  • Major Cities: 2-4 business days
  • Other Locations: 3-7 business days
  • Bulk Orders: Customized delivery schedule based on quantity and location

Track your order in real-time through our website or contact customer service for updates.
faq.q4: How can I verify my product is genuine?
faq.a4_html:
We take product authenticity seriously. Here's how to verify your Fursa/MRS products:
  • Check for the holographic security seal on the packaging
  • Scan the QR code on the product label using your smartphone
  • Send the unique product code via SMS to our verification number
  • Visit our website's product verification page
  • Look for authorized dealer stickers at point of purchase

If you suspect a counterfeit product, report it immediately to security@@fursaenergy.com
faq.q5: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a5_html:
We offer multiple convenient payment options:
  • Bank transfers (all major Nigerian banks)
  • Credit/Debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Verve)
  • Mobile money payments
  • PayPal for international customers
  • Cash on delivery (selected locations)
  • 30-day credit terms for approved distributors
faq.q6: Do you offer technical support and training?
faq.a6_html:
Yes! We provide comprehensive technical support:
  • Free product training for distributors and their sales teams
  • Technical helpline available Monday-Saturday
  • On-site support for bulk customers
  • Product selection guides and compatibility charts
  • Regular webinars on product applications

Contact our technical team at technical@@fursaenergy.com for assistance.
